sign.name: Mise en abyme
sign.operation: Tableaux of the voyage behind the couple.

scenes.world: A dark bedchamber at night lit by one lamp, the voyage remembered as faded superimposed seascapes behind the couple.

captain.asks: Tableaux of the voyage as faded sea behind the couple in a one-lamp bedchamber: the telling, the oar inland, the foretold death, sleep, dawn.
diagnosis: The bed and the sea alternate cleanly; the mise en abyme is a cut, never a superimposition.
The oar inland is a beachcomber; the foretold road has no oar and no hills.
Faces are borrowed from earlier grief and a 1940s kiss; the couple is never the same two people.

Every frame with people breaks period: modern doors, mailboxes, colour picnic, puffer coats.
The four men are never seen together; a stranger would not count them.
